_comment: Volatile CNA-derived facts for the documentation snapshot. Every value was recomputed from the CNA TARGET commit 3b43bd86 (not copied from earlier audits; method and previous value recorded in audit/3b43bd86-phase7-delta.md and audit/data/facts/3b43bd86/R1-facts-and-changes.md). Presentations on the site are validated against this file by scripts/check_facts.py. External values are pinned to a revision.

snapshot.note: The snapshot is unreleased development on branch next, 948 commits after the v0.1.0 tag; its version string is still 0.1.0. The previous snapshot c6dec91f (2026-10-24) was 812 commits after v0.1.0; the 136 commits between them are all first-parent (no merges).
snapshot.changed_paths_since_base_release_method: git diff --shortstat v0.1.0-alpha.1 TARGET with Git's default rename detection (10,273 at 3b43bd86: 3,058 A / 4,823 D / 2,359 M / 33 R by git diff --name-status; git diff --no-renames --name-status lists 10,306 records). Git skips exhaustive rename detection for a range this large and warns about diff.renameLimit; the figure is what that command prints (git 2.47.3)
snapshot.changed_paths_since_latest_release_metho: git diff --shortstat v0.1.0 TARGET (6,383 files, +237,668 / -966,681; name-status 587 A / 4,083 D / 1,700 M / 13 R; --no-renames 6,396 records). c6dec91f: 6,302
